records.question: What exactly did the Verkhovna Rada discuss in the closed part of its session last Tuesday?
records.answer: The Verkhovna Rada did not hold any session, closed or otherwise, on 29 September 2026 because parliament was in a scheduled recess from 17 September to 13 October 2026; therefore there was no closed part to discuss any topic. ⚖️
records.why: The UNN article from 19 September 2026 explicitly states that the Verkhovna Rada suspended its plenary sessions from 17 September through 13 October 2026, meaning no plenary sittings occurred on 29 September. Since there was no session, there could not be a closed part to discuss any topic.
caveats: The Rada's official calendar and chronology pages for 29 September 2026 timed out during attempts to open them, so the exact classification could not be directly verified from the primary source.
